---
# title: set by scripts/render_compare.R ("Version comparison: {a} vs {b}"); a front-matter title would win over it
subtitle: "Program-Area / Planning-Area scores. Parameterized report — overall composite and every component score, two releases side by side"
params:
  version_a: v8
  version_b: v9
  metric_key: score_extriskspcat_primprod_ecoregionrescaled_equalweights
  metric_key_v10: score_v10_equalweights_global
  mean_tol: 5
  max_tol: 15
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true    # self-contained: no sidecar _files dir (browsable standalone from the nav)
    lightbox: false          # override the project default: lightbox keeps an external href to the plot PNG
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

> **Not a pipeline stage** — a standalone, parameterized *report* (no `msens:` target block, so
> `tar_make()` never runs it). Render it on demand for any two release versions whose `sdm.duckdb`
> are on disk. The reusable comparison **core lives in `msens`** (`zone_scored_flds`, `zone_scores`,
> `zone_crosswalk`, `zone_score_delta`, `score_delta`, `score_delta_summary`,
> `assert_within_tolerance`) so this notebook only *orchestrates* — the math is unit-tested in
> `msens/tests/testthat/test-validate.R` and can't drift from what's reported here.
>
> ```r
> # render ONE pair, with the versions in the output filename (see scripts/render_compare.R):
> source("scripts/render_compare.R"); render_compare("v6", "v9")   # -> _output/compare_versions_v6_vs_v9.html
> # or from the shell:
> Rscript scripts/render_compare.R v6 v9
> # render every registered pair (data/compare_pairs.csv) that is missing, then rebuild the archive index:
> Rscript scripts/render_compare_sequence.R            # add --redo to re-render them all, or name pairs: v10:v11
> ```
>
> A bare `quarto render compare_versions.qmd` **stops**: its output would be the unversioned
> `compare_versions.html`, which is the **archive index** of every rendered pair
> (`scripts/build_compare_index.R`), and a report there is overwritten by the next version bump.
> The release lineage the archive follows (v7 → v8 → v10 → v11, and the v7 patches) is
> `data/compare_pairs.csv`.
>
> **What is compared.** Scores on each release's **principal reporting unit** — the 20 MMA
> **Program Areas** (v2 onward) or, for a release that scored none, the 36 **Planning Areas** (v1).
> Ecoregions and subregions are deliberately not reported here. When the two releases used different
> units, zones are compared **only where they are the same polygon** (`msens::zone_crosswalk()`,
> intersection over union ≥ 0.999, computed from the polygons at render time); everything else — a
> Program Area that is a *subset* of a Planning Area, a Planning Area with no Program Area — is
> listed **adjacent, not compared**, exactly as components present in only one release (v6's
> `other`, v8+'s `primary_producer`) are. The overall composite and each **component** it averages
> (`extrisk_{category}_ecoregion_rescaled` + `primprod_ecoregion_rescaled`) are shown. `Δ = B − A`.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

librarian::shelf(DBI, duckdb, dplyr, DT, ggplot2, glue, htmltools, knitr, leaflet, purrr,
                 rmapshaper, scales, sf, tidyr, MarineSensitivity/msens, quiet = TRUE)
source(here::here("libs/paths.R"))

va <- params$version_a
vb <- params$version_b
mk <- params$metric_key
stopifnot(va != vb)

# the output must name its two versions: scripts/render_compare.R sets MSENS_COMPARE_OUT to the
# versioned filename before rendering; an unversioned render would overwrite the archive index
out_expected <- glue("compare_versions_{va}_vs_{vb}.html")
if (!identical(Sys.getenv("MSENS_COMPARE_OUT"), as.character(out_expected)))
  stop(glue("render through scripts/render_compare.R ({va} vs {vb} -> _output/{out_expected}); ",
            "a bare `quarto render compare_versions.qmd` would overwrite the archive index _output/compare_versions.html"))

# resolve each version's sdm.duckdb by swapping the version segment of the configured path
sdm_for <- function(v) sub(glue("/{ver}/"), glue("/{v}/"), path.expand(sdm_db))
db_a <- sdm_for(va); db_b <- sdm_for(vb)
stopifnot(file.exists(db_a), file.exists(db_b))

con_a <- dbConnect(duckdb(), db_a, read_only = TRUE)
con_b <- dbConnect(duckdb(), db_b, read_only = TRUE)

va_col <- glue("score_{va}"); vb_col <- glue("score_{vb}")

# the principal reporting unit each release actually scored: Program Areas if it has them, else
# Planning Areas (v1); never ecoregions or subregions
UNITS <- c(programarea = "programarea_key", planarea = "planarea_key")
unit_of <- function(con, v) {
  flds <- msens::zone_scored_flds(con, mk)
  u <- UNITS[UNITS %in% flds]
  if (!length(u)) stop(glue("{v}: no Program-Area or Planning-Area zones carry `{mk}` (has: ",
                            "{paste(flds, collapse = ', ')})"))
  names(u)[1]
}
unit_a <- unit_of(con_a, va); unit_b <- unit_of(con_b, vb)
fld_a  <- UNITS[[unit_a]];    fld_b  <- UNITS[[unit_b]]
unit_label <- c(programarea = "Program Area", planarea = "Planning Area")

cat(glue("Comparing **{va}** (A) ← → **{vb}** (B)  \n",
         "- A ({va}): `{db_a}` — scored on **{unit_label[[unit_a]]}s** (`{fld_a}`)  \n",
         "- B ({vb}): `{db_b}` — scored on **{unit_label[[unit_b]]}s** (`{fld_b}`)  \n",
         "- composite metric: `{mk}`\n"))
```

### Zone polygons

The choropleths and the crosswalk need each unit's geometry. It is resolved from the derived tree by
**content**, not by filename: every `ply_{unit}s_*.gpkg` under `dir_derived` is fingerprinted with
`msens::zone_geom_hash()` and the first whose hash equals that unit's entry in `data/zone_sets.csv`
is used — so the map can never silently draw a different vintage than the scores were computed on.

```{r}
#| label: geometry

zone_sets <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/zone_sets.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

resolve_ply <- function(unit) {
  zs <- zone_sets |> filter(zone_type == unit)
  stopifnot(nrow(zs) >= 1)
  zs <- zs[1, ]
  cands <- list.files(path.expand(dir_derived), pattern = glue("^ply_{unit}s_.*\\.gpkg$"),
                      recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  for (f in cands) {
    x <- sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
    h <- tryCatch(msens::zone_geom_hash(x, zone_type = unit)$geom_hash, error = function(e) NA)
    if (identical(h, zs$geom_hash)) {
      key <- UNITS[[unit]]; nm <- glue("{unit}_name")
      x <- x |>
        transmute(zone_key = as.character(.data[[key]]), zone_name = .data[[nm]],
                  region = if ("region_key" %in% names(x)) region_key else NA_character_,
                  hint   = if ("planarea_key" %in% names(x) && unit != "planarea") planarea_key
                           else NA_character_) |>
        st_make_valid()
      attr(x, "src") <- f; attr(x, "zone_set_key") <- zs$zone_set_key
      return(x)
    }
  }
  stop(glue("no ply_{unit}s_*.gpkg under {dir_derived} matches geom_hash {zs$geom_hash} ",
            "({zs$zone_set_key}); candidates: {paste(cands, collapse = ', ')}"))
}
ply_a <- resolve_ply(unit_a)
ply_b <- if (unit_b == unit_a) ply_a else resolve_ply(unit_b)

for (p in unique(list(ply_a, ply_b)))
  cat(glue("- `{sub(path.expand(dir_derived), '', attr(p, 'src'))}` — {attr(p, 'zone_set_key')}, ",
           "{nrow(p)} zones\n\n"))
```

### Crosswalk: which zones are compared

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk

if (unit_a == unit_b) {
  xw <- tibble(key_a = ply_a$zone_key, key_b = ply_a$zone_key, iou = 1, identical = TRUE)
} else {
  hint <- if (!all(is.na(ply_b$hint))) "hint" else NULL
  xw <- msens::zone_crosswalk(ply_a, ply_b, "zone_key", "zone_key", hint = hint) |> as_tibble()
}
# key_a -> key_b for the compared (identical) pairs; every other zone is one-sided
xw_id <- xw |> filter(identical)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(xw_id$key_a)), !any(duplicated(xw_id$key_b)))
map_ab <- setNames(xw_id$key_b, xw_id$key_a)

only_a_zones <- setdiff(ply_a$zone_key, xw_id$key_a)
only_b_zones <- setdiff(ply_b$zone_key, xw_id$key_b)

# why a one-sided zone is not compared
why_not <- function(k, side) {
  if (unit_a == unit_b) return(glue("not in {if (side == 'a') vb else va}"))
  r <- if (side == "a") xw |> filter(grepl(paste0("(^|,)", k, "(,|$)"), key_a)) else xw |> filter(key_b == k)
  if (!nrow(r)) return(glue("no {unit_label[[if (side == 'a') unit_b else unit_a]]} covers it"))
  glue("partial overlap only — {if (side == 'a') r$key_b[1] else r$key_a[1]} (IoU {max(r$iou)})")
}

cat(glue("- {unit_label[[unit_a]]}s in {va}: **{nrow(ply_a)}**; {unit_label[[unit_b]]}s in {vb}: ",
         "**{nrow(ply_b)}**  \n",
         "- zones compared (same polygon): **{nrow(xw_id)}**  \n",
         "- only in {va}, listed not compared: **{length(only_a_zones)}**",
         if (length(only_a_zones)) glue(" ({paste(only_a_zones, collapse = ', ')})") else "", "  \n",
         "- only in {vb}, listed not compared: **{length(only_b_zones)}**",
         if (length(only_b_zones)) glue(" ({paste(only_b_zones, collapse = ', ')})") else "", "\n"))

if (unit_a != unit_b)
  knitr::kable(xw |> arrange(desc(identical), key_b),
               caption = glue("Every candidate pair, {unit_label[[unit_a]]} ({va}) → ",
                              "{unit_label[[unit_b]]} ({vb}); only `identical` pairs are compared"))
```

```{r}
#| label: map-layer

# one drawing layer: compared zones (B geometry, both keys), B-only zones, A-only zones (A geometry)
zone_names <- bind_rows(
  st_drop_geometry(ply_b) |> transmute(key_b = zone_key, name_b = zone_name, region_b = region),
  tibble(key_b = character(), name_b = character(), region_b = character()))
ply_draw <- bind_rows(
  ply_b |> filter(zone_key %in% xw_id$key_b) |>
    mutate(key_b = zone_key, key_a = names(map_ab)[match(zone_key, map_ab)], status = "compared"),
  ply_b |> filter(zone_key %in% only_b_zones) |>
    mutate(key_b = zone_key, key_a = NA_character_, status = glue("only in {vb}")),
  ply_a |> filter(zone_key %in% only_a_zones) |>
    mutate(key_b = NA_character_, key_a = zone_key, status = glue("only in {va}"))) |>
  mutate(zone_key = coalesce(key_b, key_a),
         label = ifelse(status == "compared" & unit_a != unit_b, glue("{key_a} → {key_b}"), zone_key)) |>
  select(zone_key, key_a, key_b, zone_name, region, status, label)
# ~450k vertices are far more than a choropleth of a few dozen polygons needs
ply_s <- rmapshaper::ms_simplify(ply_draw, keep = 0.02, keep_shapes = TRUE) |> st_make_valid()
# Leaflet: shift to 0–360 so the Aleutian polygons that straddle the antimeridian draw as one
ply_l <- st_shift_longitude(ply_s)
bb_l  <- st_bbox(ply_l)
names_draw <- st_drop_geometry(ply_draw) |> select(zone_key, key_a, key_b, zone_name, region, status)
cat(glue("drawing {nrow(ply_draw)} zones ({sum(ply_draw$status == 'compared')} compared); simplified ",
         "{nrow(st_coordinates(ply_draw))} → {nrow(st_coordinates(ply_s))} vertices"))
```

### Report helpers

Presentation only — every number comes from the `msens` core.

```{r}
#| label: helpers

# diverging background for a Δ column: n colours need n-1 cut points
div_style <- function(x, n = 8) {
  lim <- max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- 1
  list(brks = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = n + 1)[2:n],
       cols = colorRampPalette(c("#e8590c", "#ffffff", "#20c997"))(n))
}

# choropleth: three base layers (A score, B score, Δ) on one map; hover shows all three.
# `d` is keyed by the B zone key for compared zones; one-sided zones come from the long frames.
zone_map <- function(d, sa, sb, title) {
  x <- ply_l |>
    left_join(d |> select(key_b = zone_key, a = all_of(va_col), b = all_of(vb_col), delta), by = "key_b") |>
    left_join(sa |> select(key_a = zone_key, a1 = score), by = "key_a") |>
    left_join(sb |> select(key_b = zone_key, b1 = score), by = "key_b") |>
    mutate(a = coalesce(a, a1), b = coalesce(b, b1),
           delta = ifelse(status == "compared", delta, NA_real_))
  rng <- range(c(x$a, x$b), na.rm = TRUE)
  lim <- max(abs(x$delta), na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- 1
  pal_s <- colorNumeric("viridis", domain = rng, na.color = "#00000000")
  pal_d <- colorNumeric(c("#e8590c", "#f8f9fa", "#20c997"), domain = c(-lim, lim), na.color = "#00000000")
  fmt <- function(v, f = "%.2f") ifelse(is.na(v), "—", sprintf(f, v))
  lbl <- glue("<b>{x$label}</b> {x$zone_name}<br/>",
              "{va}: {fmt(x$a)}<br/>{vb}: {fmt(x$b)}<br/>Δ: {fmt(x$delta, '%+.2f')}",
              "{ifelse(x$status == 'compared', '', paste0('<br/><i>', x$status, ' — not compared</i>'))}") |>
    lapply(HTML)
  dash <- ifelse(x$status == "compared", "", "6 4")   # one-sided zones: dashed outline
  poly <- function(m, fill, grp) {
    m |> addPolygons(
      fillColor = fill, fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#555", weight = 0.7, opacity = 0.8,
      dashArray = dash, label = lbl, group = grp,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#000", bringToFront = TRUE))
  }
  # Esri's grey canvas needs no API key (CARTO's basemaps now do)
  leaflet(x, options = leafletOptions(worldCopyJump = FALSE)) |>
    addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
    fitBounds(bb_l[["xmin"]], bb_l[["ymin"]], bb_l[["xmax"]], bb_l[["ymax"]]) |>
    poly(~pal_s(a), va) |>
    poly(~pal_s(b), vb) |>
    poly(~pal_d(delta), "Δ") |>
    addLegend(pal = pal_s, values = c(x$a, x$b), title = glue("{title}<br/>score ({va}, {vb})"),
              position = "bottomleft", na.label = "") |>
    addLegend(pal = pal_d, values = c(-lim, lim), title = glue("{title}<br/>Δ {vb} − {va}"),
              position = "bottomright", na.label = "") |>
    addLayersControl(baseGroups = c(va, vb, "Δ"), position = "topright",
                     options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
}

# sortable table of the compared zones: keys, both scores, Δ and Δ %, coloured on Δ
zone_table <- function(d, caption) {
  t <- d |>
    left_join(names_draw |> filter(status == "compared") |> select(-status), by = c("zone_key" = "key_b")) |>
    transmute(!!glue("{unit_label[[unit_a]]} ({va})") := key_a,
              !!glue("{unit_label[[unit_b]]} ({vb})") := zone_key,
              Name = zone_name, Region = region,
              !!va := round(.data[[va_col]], 2),
              !!vb := round(.data[[vb_col]], 2),
              `Δ` = round(delta, 2),
              `Δ %` = ifelse(.data[[va_col]] != 0, round(100 * delta / .data[[va_col]], 1), NA)) |>
    arrange(desc(abs(`Δ`)))
  if (unit_a == unit_b) t <- t[-1]      # one key column when the units are the same
  ds <- div_style(t$`Δ`)
  DT::datatable(t, rownames = FALSE, caption = caption,
                options = list(pageLength = 40, dom = "t", order = list(list(ncol(t) - 2, "desc")))) |>
    DT::formatStyle("Δ", backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(ds$brks, ds$cols))
}

# the one-sided zones, with their score in the version that has them — adjacent, not compared
adjacent_table <- function(sa, sb, caption) {
  t <- bind_rows(
    sa |> filter(zone_key %in% only_a_zones) |>
      left_join(st_drop_geometry(ply_a) |> select(zone_key, zone_name, region), by = "zone_key") |>
      transmute(version = va, unit = unit_label[[unit_a]], zone = zone_key, Name = zone_name,
                Region = region, score = round(score, 2),
                `why not compared` = vapply(zone_key, why_not, "", side = "a")),
    sb |> filter(zone_key %in% only_b_zones) |>
      left_join(st_drop_geometry(ply_b) |> select(zone_key, zone_name, region), by = "zone_key") |>
      transmute(version = vb, unit = unit_label[[unit_b]], zone = zone_key, Name = zone_name,
                Region = region, score = round(score, 2),
                `why not compared` = vapply(zone_key, why_not, "", side = "b")))
  if (!nrow(t)) return(cat("none — every zone of both releases is compared.\n"))
  DT::datatable(t, rownames = FALSE, caption = caption,
                options = list(pageLength = 40, dom = "t", order = list(list(5, "desc"))))
}

# per-metric delta from the two long score frames (A keys already mapped onto B keys)
metric_delta <- function(m) {
  msens::score_delta(
    scores_a_m |> filter(metric_key == m),
    scores_b   |> filter(metric_key == m),
    key = "zone_key", value = "score", labels = c(va, vb))
}
```

## Scores

Every zone-level score of both releases is read once (`msens::zone_scores()`); A's keys are mapped
onto B's through the crosswalk, and only the compared zones enter any delta.

```{r}
#| label: scores

scores_a <- msens::zone_scores(con_a, fld = fld_a, zone_set_key = attr(ply_a, "zone_set_key"), label = va)
scores_b <- msens::zone_scores(con_b, fld = fld_b, zone_set_key = attr(ply_b, "zone_set_key"), label = vb)
scores_a_m <- scores_a |> filter(zone_key %in% names(map_ab)) |> mutate(zone_key = unname(map_ab[zone_key]))
zd <- msens::zone_score_delta(scores_a_m, scores_b |> filter(zone_key %in% xw_id$key_b), labels = c(va, vb))
cat(glue("{nrow(scores_a)} (zone × metric) rows in {va}, {nrow(scores_b)} in {vb}; ",
         "{zd$n_zones_shared} zones and {nrow(zd$by_metric)} metrics compared"))
```

## Overall composite score

The headline equivalence gate: the composite (`{r} mk`) per compared zone in each version.

```{r}
#| label: composite-delta

d <- metric_delta(mk)
s <- msens::score_delta_summary(d)

# soft equivalence verdict — report, never hard-stop (a report must render either way)
gate <- tryCatch(
  { msens::assert_within_tolerance(d, mean_tol = params$mean_tol, max_tol = params$max_tol); "PASS" },
  error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))

knitr::kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = c("zones compared", "mean |Δ|", "max |Δ|", "RMSE", "correlation",
               "tolerance (mean / max)", "verdict"),
    value  = c(s$n, round(s$mean_abs, 3), round(s$max_abs, 3), round(s$rmse, 3),
               round(cor(d[[va_col]], d[[vb_col]]), 4),
               glue("{params$mean_tol} / {params$max_tol}"),
               ifelse(gate == "PASS", "✅ within tolerance", paste0("⚠️ ", gate)))),
  caption = glue("Composite-score equivalence, {va} → {vb}"))
```

### Map

Switch between **`{r} va`**, **`{r} vb`** and **Δ** with the radio buttons; hover a zone for all
three values. Both score layers share one colour scale so they are directly comparable. Zones with a
**dashed outline** exist in one release only: they carry that release's score in its layer and no Δ.

```{r}
#| label: composite-map
zone_map(d, scores_a |> filter(metric_key == mk), scores_b |> filter(metric_key == mk), "Composite")
```

### Table

Click a column header to sort by zone, score or difference.

```{r}
#| label: composite-table
zone_table(d, glue("Composite score per compared zone, {va} vs {vb}"))
```

### Adjacent, not compared

```{r}
#| label: composite-adjacent
adjacent_table(scores_a |> filter(metric_key == mk), scores_b |> filter(metric_key == mk),
               glue("Zones present in one release only, with their composite score there"))
```

```{r}
#| label: composite-plot
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

d_plot <- d |>
  mutate(zone_key = factor(zone_key, levels = zone_key[order(delta)]),
         sign = ifelse(delta >= 0, glue("higher in {vb}"), glue("higher in {va}")))

ggplot(d_plot, aes(delta, zone_key, fill = sign)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#20c997", "#e8590c"),
                                      c(glue("higher in {vb}"), glue("higher in {va}")))) +
  labs(x = glue("Δ composite score  ({vb} − {va})"), y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = glue("Composite-score change per compared zone: {va} → {vb}")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Component scores

`msens::zone_score_delta()` compares only shared zones and metrics and **returns what it had to
drop**, so a component one release lacks is listed, never compared against nothing.

```{r}
#| label: components

is_component <- function(m) grepl("^extrisk_[a-z_]+_ecoregion_rescaled$", m) |
                            m == "primprod_ecoregion_rescaled"
comp_label <- function(m) ifelse(m == "primprod_ecoregion_rescaled", "primary productivity",
                                 sub("^extrisk_(.*)_ecoregion_rescaled$", "\\1", m))
comp_title <- function(m) tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", comp_label(m)))

comps <- zd$by_metric |>
  filter(is_component(metric_key)) |>
  mutate(component = comp_label(metric_key)) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_delta))

only_a <- zd$metrics_only_a[is_component(zd$metrics_only_a)]
only_b <- zd$metrics_only_b[is_component(zd$metrics_only_b)]

cat(glue("- components compared: **{nrow(comps)}**  \n",
         "- components only in {va} (listed, not compared): ",
         if (length(only_a)) paste0("`", only_a, "`", collapse = ", ") else "none", "  \n",
         "- components only in {vb} (listed, not compared): ",
         if (length(only_b)) paste0("`", only_b, "`", collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n"))
```

### Summary by component

`n` is the number of compared zones carrying that component in **both** versions (a category absent
from a zone, e.g. coral in the Arctic, has no row there).

```{r}
#| label: components-summary

comps |>
  transmute(component, metric_key, n = n_zones,
            !!glue("mean {va}") := round(mean_a, 2), !!glue("mean {vb}") := round(mean_b, 2),
            `mean Δ` = round(mean_delta, 2), `mean |Δ|` = round(mean_abs_delta, 2),
            `max |Δ|` = round(max_abs_delta, 2), r = round(cor, 3)) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 25),
                caption = glue("Per-component delta over the compared zones, {va} → {vb}, sorted by mean |Δ|"))
```

### Δ by zone × component

One cell per (compared zone, component): Δ = B − A. Sort any column to find where a component moved
most.

```{r}
#| label: components-heatmap

comp_keys  <- comps$metric_key
comp_delta <- setNames(lapply(comp_keys, metric_delta), comp_keys)

wide <- bind_rows(
    lapply(comp_keys, function(m) comp_delta[[m]] |> transmute(zone_key, component = comp_label(m), delta)),
    d |> transmute(zone_key, component = "COMPOSITE", delta)) |>
  mutate(delta = round(delta, 2)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = delta) |>
  left_join(names_draw |> filter(status == "compared") |> select(key_b, zone_name, region), by = c("zone_key" = "key_b")) |>
  relocate(zone_key, zone_name, region, COMPOSITE) |>
  rename(Zone = zone_key, Name = zone_name, Region = region) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(COMPOSITE)))

num_cols <- names(wide)[sapply(wide, is.numeric)]
ds <- div_style(unlist(wide[num_cols]), n = 10)
DT::datatable(wide, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 40, scrollX = TRUE),
              caption = glue("Δ ({vb} − {va}) per compared zone and component")) |>
  DT::formatStyle(num_cols, backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(ds$brks, ds$cols))
```

## Across the nation: the v10 distribution share

Everything above is **within ecoregion**: a species' importance in a Program Area is rescaled against
the other cells of the *ecoregion* that Program Area sits in, so a quiet ecoregion's best Program Area
can outscore a busy ecoregion's. The v10 score is **across the nation**: for each category the score
is the Program Area's risk-weighted share of each species' distribution, divided by the area's share
of the nation, so **100 = the national-average concentration** and 250 holds two and a half times its
area's fair share. It is computed under three denominators (`global` = the species' whole range, the
headline; `usa` = its US slice; `pooled`), with the companion **percent of the world** beside it, and
a category with too little coverage in a Program Area is **not reportable** (no row, never zero — the
floor). This section runs only when version B carries `{r} params$metric_key_v10`.

### How the national score is built {.unnumbered}

The rule is `msens::share_sql()` (unit-tested in `test-share.R`); in words, for each scored species *s*
and category *g*:

1. **Value × area.** Each cell's merged value (0–100) times its area: how much of the species' habitat
   the cell holds.
2. **Divide by the denominator** (below): the species' total, so its cells sum to a fixed amount.
3. **Weight by extinction risk** and **sum over the species of the category** in the Program Area.
4. **Per km², against the nation.** Divide the area's total by the nation's, and by the area's share
   of the national area: **100 = the national-average concentration**; 200 = twice its fair share.
5. A category whose scored cells cover less than κ = 5 % of the area is **not reportable** (absent,
   never zero). The **composite** is the equal-weight mean of the reportable categories, productivity
   included.

**The three denominators** change only step 2, i.e. *how much each species can contribute in total*:

| denominator | each species is divided by | so a species counts | reads as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `global` (headline) | its total over its **whole modelled range**, worldwide | in proportion to the **fraction of its range in US waters** (× risk): a US-centred species counts fully, a species mostly elsewhere counts little | "how much of each species' *world* distribution is here" |
| `usa` | its total over **US waters** only | **the same** for every species nationally (× risk), however widespread | "how much of each species' *US* distribution is here"; areas add to 100 % of the nation |
| `pooled` | **nothing**: no per-species normalization | in proportion to its **habitat area × value**: widespread species dominate, narrow-range species weigh little | "how much habitat is here"; the RESA 1 arithmetic (value × area, then a percent of the national total) |

*Example.* A species found only in Cook Inlet gives Cook Inlet 100 % of its weight under `usa`. Under
`global` that weight shrinks by the part of its range outside the US. Under `pooled` it counts only by its
habitat area, so a small range adds little. Where the three agree, the choice does not matter for that area.

```{r}
#| label: v10-setup

mk_v10 <- params$metric_key_v10
mk_eco <- "score_extriskspcat_primprod_ecoregionrescaled_equalweights"
has_v10 <- unit_b == "programarea" &&
  "programarea_key" %in% msens::zone_scored_flds(con_b, mk_v10)
if (!has_v10) cat(glue("`{vb}` carries no Program-Area `{mk_v10}`: the v10 section is skipped."))

# vector helpers over the 20 Program Areas of B (A is already keyed onto B's zones)
pa <- st_drop_geometry(ply_b) |> select(zone_key, zone_name, region)
col_of <- function(df, m) {
  if (is.na(m)) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(pa)))
  x <- df[df$metric_key == m, ]
  x$score[match(pa$zone_key, x$zone_key)]
}
rk <- function(x) rank(-x, ties.method = "min", na.last = "keep")             # 1 = highest
rho <- function(x, y) suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
```

### Re-issued Program-Area table

One row per Program Area: the published composite of **A**, B's own **ecoregional** composite (B keeps
v8's within-ecoregion metrics unchanged, so this is the data rebuild alone), and the v10
across-the-nation composite under each denominator plus the floor-strip sensitivity (`global_strip`:
the floor removed, so the areas it hides appear). Ranks run 1 = highest; Δrank = rank in A − rank in
v10 global, so a positive value is a Program Area that moves **up** under v10.

```{r}
#| label: v10-pa-table

if (has_v10) {
  tab <- pa |> mutate(
    a      = col_of(scores_a_m, mk),
    eco    = col_of(scores_b, mk_eco),
    global = col_of(scores_b, mk_v10),
    usa    = col_of(scores_b, "score_v10_equalweights_usa"),
    pooled = col_of(scores_b, "score_v10_equalweights_pooled"),
    strip  = col_of(scores_b, "score_v10_equalweights_global_strip"),
    n_comp = col_of(scores_b, "score_v10_n_components_global")) |>
    mutate(across(c(a, eco, global, usa, pooled, strip), rk, .names = "rk_{.col}"),
           d_rank = rk_a - rk_global) |>
    arrange(desc(global))
  cols_v10 <- c("global", "usa", "pooled", "strip")
  rho_tab <- tibble(ranking = cols_v10,
                    `ρ vs A` = sapply(cols_v10, \(k) rho(tab[[k]], tab$a)),
                    `ρ vs B ecoregional` = sapply(cols_v10, \(k) rho(tab[[k]], tab$eco)))
  cap <- glue("Composite per Program Area, sorted by v10 global. Spearman ρ of the v10 ranking against ",
              "{va}'s / B's ecoregional: ",
              paste(glue("{rho_tab$ranking} {round(rho_tab[[2]], 2)} / {round(rho_tab[[3]], 2)}"), collapse = "; "))
  tab |>
    transmute(`Program Area` = zone_key, Name = zone_name,
              !!glue("{va} published") := round(a, 1), `B ecoregional` = round(eco, 1),
              `v10 global` = round(global, 1), `v10 usa` = round(usa, 1), `v10 pooled` = round(pooled, 1),
              `v10 global_strip` = round(strip, 1), `n components` = n_comp,
              !!glue("rank {va}") := rk_a, `rank B eco` = rk_eco, `rank global` = rk_global,
              `rank usa` = rk_usa, `rank pooled` = rk_pooled, `rank strip` = rk_strip,
              `Δrank` = d_rank) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, caption = cap,
                  options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE))
}
```

### Per component

The same comparison one category at a time. The two ecoregional columns are the within-ecoregion
component (A, B); `v10 global` is the across-the-nation score (100 = national average) with
`% of world` — the share of the world's risk-weighted distribution that sits in the Program Area —
its number of species and the area's `coverage`. **n/r** = not reportable: the category has coverage
in the area but too little to publish a score (the floor), so no row exists.

```{r}
#| label: v10-components

if (has_v10) {
  cats <- scores_b$metric_key |> unique()
  cats <- sort(unique(sub("^extrisk_(.*)_(v10_global|coverage)$", "\\1",
                          cats[grepl("^extrisk_(.*)_(v10_global|coverage)$", cats)])))
  spec <- bind_rows(
    tibble(component = cats,
           eco = glue("extrisk_{cats}_ecoregion_rescaled"), v10 = glue("extrisk_{cats}_v10_global"),
           cov = glue("extrisk_{cats}_coverage"), world = glue("extrisk_{cats}_pct_world"),
           nsp = glue("extrisk_{cats}_n_species"), usa = glue("extrisk_{cats}_v10_usa"),
           pooled = glue("extrisk_{cats}_v10_pooled")),
    tibble(component = "primprod", eco = "primprod_ecoregion_rescaled", v10 = "primprod_v10",
           cov = "primprod_coverage", world = NA_character_, nsp = NA_character_,
           usa = NA_character_, pooled = NA_character_))
  comp_tab <- purrr::pmap_dfr(spec, function(component, eco, v10, cov, world, nsp, usa, pooled) {
    cv <- col_of(scores_b, cov)
    # absent v10 row + coverage present = "n/r"; no coverage either = blank
    fmt <- function(v) ifelse(!is.na(v), sprintf("%.1f", v), ifelse(!is.na(cv), "n/r", ""))
    # .env$: the column named after version A (`va`, e.g. "v10") is built first in this tibble() and would
    # otherwise shadow the function argument of the same name inside the data mask (render of v10 vs v11, 2026-11-02)
    tibble(`Program Area` = pa$zone_key, Component = component,
           !!va := round(col_of(scores_a_m, .env$eco), 1), `B ecoregional` = round(col_of(scores_b, .env$eco), 1),
           `v10 global` = fmt(col_of(scores_b, .env$v10)), `% of world` = round(col_of(scores_b, .env$world), 2),
           coverage = round(cv, 3), `n species` = col_of(scores_b, .env$nsp),
           `v10 usa` = fmt(col_of(scores_b, .env$usa)), `v10 pooled` = fmt(col_of(scores_b, .env$pooled)))
  }) |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[va]]) | !is.na(`B ecoregional`) | `v10 global` != "" | !is.na(coverage))
  DT::datatable(comp_tab, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(1, "asc"))),
                caption = glue("Program Area × component: {va} and B ecoregional (within ecoregion) vs v10 (across the nation)"))
}
```

### Attribution: v7 → v8 → v10

Two things changed between the published release and v10, and they are kept apart here. **A → B
ecoregional** is the *data rebuild* (new models, same within-ecoregion scoring): both scores are on
one scale, so it gets the usual deltas and gate statistics. **B ecoregional → v10 global** is the
*scoring change*: the scale itself changes (a rescaled 0–100 index becomes a concentration index
around 100), so a score delta is meaningless and it is reported as rank movement and Spearman ρ only.

```{r}
#| label: v10-attribution

if (has_v10) {
  d_eco <- msens::score_delta(scores_a_m |> filter(metric_key == mk),
                              scores_b   |> filter(metric_key == mk_eco),
                              key = "zone_key", value = "score", labels = c(va, vb))
  s_eco <- msens::score_delta_summary(d_eco)
  step_tab <- tibble(
    step = c(glue("{va} → B ecoregional (data rebuild)"),
             "B ecoregional → v10 global (scoring change)", glue("{va} → v10 global (both)")),
    `same scale` = c("yes", "no", "no"), zones = c(s_eco$n, sum(!is.na(tab$eco + tab$global)), sum(!is.na(tab$a + tab$global))),
    `mean |Δ|` = c(round(s_eco$mean_abs, 2), NA, NA), `max |Δ|` = c(round(s_eco$max_abs, 2), NA, NA),
    `r` = c(round(cor(d_eco[[va_col]], d_eco[[vb_col]]), 3), NA, NA),
    `Spearman ρ` = round(c(rho(tab$a, tab$eco), rho(tab$eco, tab$global), rho(tab$a, tab$global)), 3))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v10-attribution-steps

if (has_v10) knitr::kable(step_tab, caption = "Gate statistics per step (score deltas only where the scales match)")
```

```{r}
#| label: v10-attribution-table

if (has_v10) {
  tab |>
    transmute(`Program Area` = zone_key, !!va := round(a, 1), `B ecoregional` = round(eco, 1),
              `v10 global` = round(global, 1), `Δ data (B eco − A)` = round(eco - a, 1),
              `rank A` = rk_a, `rank B eco` = rk_eco, `rank v10` = rk_global,
              `Δrank data` = rk_a - rk_eco, `Δrank scoring` = rk_eco - rk_global) |>
    arrange(desc(`v10 global`)) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
                  caption = "Per Program Area: the data-rebuild delta and the scoring-change rank move (positive = moves up)")
}
```

### Sea turtles by species

Turtles are the category the across-the-nation view changes most: a few Program Areas hold nearly all
of a species' world distribution weight while most hold none. For each Program Area and species,
`share_global` is the share of the **world** distribution (risk-weighted) inside the area,
`share_usa` the share of the species' **US slice**, and `share_v10_contrib` its contribution to the
area's turtle total under the headline global denominator. Areas are ordered by region (Alaska,
Pacific, Gulf, Atlantic).

```{r}
#| label: v10-turtles

if (has_v10) {
  zc <- msens::sdm_val_col(con_b, "zone")
  # region of a Program Area = the subregion covering most of its cells
  reg <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con_b, glue("
      SELECT pa.{zc} AS zone_key, s.{zc} AS subregion, count(*) AS n
      FROM zone pa JOIN zone_cell zp ON zp.zone_seq = pa.zone_seq
      JOIN zone_cell zs ON zs.cell_id = zp.cell_id JOIN zone s ON s.zone_seq = zs.zone_seq
      WHERE pa.fld = 'programarea_key' AND s.fld = 'subregion_key'
      GROUP BY 1, 2")) |> as_tibble() |> group_by(zone_key) |> slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      ungroup() |> select(zone_key, subregion),
    error = function(e) tibble(zone_key = character(), subregion = character()))
  reg_ord <- c("AK", "PA", "GA", "AT")                       # Alaska, Pacific, Gulf, Atlantic
  zt <- dbGetQuery(con_b, "SELECT zone_value AS zone_key, mdl_key, sp_common, sp_scientific,
                             share_usa, share_global, share_v10_contrib
                           FROM zone_taxon WHERE sp_cat = 'turtle' AND zone_fld = 'programarea_key'") |>
    as_tibble() |> mutate(species = coalesce(sp_common, sp_scientific))
  turt <- pa |> select(zone_key, zone_name) |>
    left_join(reg, by = "zone_key") |>
    left_join(zt |> mutate(share_global = round(100 * share_global, 2)) |>
                select(zone_key, species, share_global) |>
                pivot_wider(names_from = species, values_from = share_global), by = "zone_key") |>
    mutate(`turtle v10 global` = round(col_of(scores_b, "extrisk_turtle_v10_global"), 1)[match(zone_key, pa$zone_key)],
           `% of world` = round(col_of(scores_b, "extrisk_turtle_pct_world"), 2)[match(zone_key, pa$zone_key)],
           ord = match(subregion, reg_ord, nomatch = 99L)) |>
    arrange(ord, zone_key) |> select(-ord) |> rename(`Program Area` = zone_key, Name = zone_name, Region = subregion)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v10-turtles-wide

# one row per Program Area, a column per species: % of the world's distribution inside the area
if (has_v10) {
  DT::datatable(turt, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
                caption = "Sea turtles: world share (%) per species and the Program Area's turtle v10 score") |>
    DT::formatRound(setdiff(names(turt)[sapply(turt, is.numeric)], "turtle v10 global"), 2)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v10-turtles-long

if (has_v10) {
  zt |> transmute(`Program Area` = zone_key, Species = species, `share usa` = signif(share_usa, 3),
                  `share global` = signif(share_global, 3), `contribution to v10` = signif(share_v10_contrib, 3)) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 15),
                  caption = "Long form: every (Program Area, turtle species) row of zone_taxon")
}
```

### The three denominators

The same composite under the three denominators (defined in [How the national score is
built](#how-the-national-score-is-built)), one row per Program Area sorted by the global headline.
Where the three dots coincide the denominator does not matter; where they spread, the answer depends
on whether each species is weighed by its share of its **world** range (`global`), of its **US** range
(`usa`), or by its raw **habitat area** (`pooled`). All three are relative to the national average, so a spread
says how an area's species differ from the nation's mix: higher under `global` than under `usa` = its
species are more US-centred than most; higher under `global` than under `pooled` = more of its weight
comes from narrow-range species. The dashed line is 100, the national average.

```{r}
#| label: v10-denominators
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-width: 8

if (has_v10) {
  den <- tab |> select(zone_key, global, usa, pooled) |>
    pivot_longer(-zone_key, names_to = "denominator", values_to = "score") |>
    mutate(zone_key = factor(zone_key, levels = tab$zone_key[order(tab$global, na.last = FALSE)]),
           denominator = factor(denominator, c("global", "usa", "pooled")))
  # Okabe-Ito: colour-blind safe
  pal <- c(global = "#0072B2", usa = "#E69F00", pooled = "#009E73")
  g <- ggplot(den, aes(score, zone_key, colour = denominator)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = zone_key), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 2.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(x = glue("{vb} national composite  (100 = national average{if (all(den$score > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) '; log scale' else ''})"),
         y = NULL, colour = "denominator",
         title = glue("Across-the-nation composite under three denominators ({vb})")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")
  # log axis when every score is positive (a concentration index spans orders of magnitude)
  if (all(den$score > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) g <- g + scale_x_log10()
  g
}
```

## Attribution: which flag moved which score

This section runs only when version B has an attribution set (`data/{vb}/attribution/`, today only
v11) **and** version A is B's `prev` in `data/versions.csv`, since the attribution's control run reproduces
that release (v11's control reproduces v10).

v11 changes the method in eight independent ways, each a flag in `libs/vars.R`. The **control** run has
every flag at its v10 value (so it reproduces v10); the **candidate** has every flag on. Each other run is
the candidate with **one** flag back at its control value (`no_<flag>`, and `nc_atl_2018` for the Atlantic
bird source), so the candidate minus that run is what the flag owns. Three settings were decided **after**
the candidate and are shown as steps of their own in [After the candidate](#after-the-candidate-single-counting-and-the-range-fill).
`scripts/attribution_runs.sh` makes the runs and `snapshot_scores.qmd` writes each run's zone scores to
`data/v11/attribution/{variant}.parquet`; this section reads whatever of that set exists, says which runs
are missing, and computes every number below from the files. It reads no `sdm.duckdb`.

**What each flag means**

| flag | off (v10) | on (v11) |
|---|---|---|
| `vgpm_integrated` | productivity = mean of the months with a satellite retrieval, which over-weights the Arctic summer | productivity **integrated over all 12 months**, a month without a retrieval (polar night, ice) counting 0 |
| `turtle_suit` | sea-turtle suitability from AquaMaps | from **our own turtle models** (`og`, the OBIS / MPA Europe method on the global grid) |
| `turtle_rule` | turtles merged multiplicatively (risk × suitability, v4b rule) | turtles merged by the **DPS rule**: suitability inside the risk footprint, the per-cell risk kept beside it and multiplied in at scoring |
| `occ_rule` | no occurrence gate | the occurrence **gate**: a species is **dropped** from an ecoregion with **no OBIS record** under adequate search effort (critical habitat, core areas, narrow-range species and unsearched ecoregions excepted) |
| `region_weight` | no weight | the occurrence **weight**: where a species is recorded but rarely, its value is multiplied by its record rate there over its rate elsewhere (0 < w < 1) |
| `fold_density` | survey density models catalogued, not scored | survey densities (Gulf cetaceans `gm`, NCCOS seabirds `nc`, California Current cetaceans `cce`), put on the 0–100 scale by their population percentile, **replace suitability inside their survey domain** |
| `components_v11` | labels "primary producers", "primary productivity" | labels **Flora**, **Productivity** (no score change) |
| `nc_atl_source` | Atlantic seabird models from 2018 | from the **2023** MDAT v3 models (BOEM 2023-060) |

and, decided after the candidate:

| setting | values | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `share_basis` | `taxon` (v4–v10) / **`cell`** (v11) | **single counting.** Under `taxon` a range cell's merged value is the larger of the species' risk score and its suitability, and the score then multiplies by the risk again, so risk is counted **twice** (on a range-only cell, er²/100). Under `cell` a range cell carries the **suitability alone** and risk enters **once**, at scoring. |
| `range_fill` | `er` / `presence` / **`mean`** (v11) | with `share_basis = cell`, the value of a **range cell no suitability model covers**: the species' risk score (`er`, which still counts risk twice on those cells), 100 (`presence`, the whole unmodelled range as full habitat), or the **mean of the species' modelled range cells** (`mean`; 100 when nothing models any of its range). |
| `fold_density_cal` | `none` / `mass` / **`suit`** (v11) | how a folded-in survey is rescaled to the surface it replaces: not at all, preserving its total (`mass`), or matching the suitability's level (`suit`; scores within 0.1 of `mass`) |

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-setup
#| results: asis

# the registry of variants and their single flag swaps is PARSED from the runner, so it cannot drift
att_dir <- here::here("data", vb, "attribution")
vers_csv <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/versions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
prev_b   <- vers_csv$prev[match(vb, vers_csv$ver)]
att_ok   <- dir.exists(att_dir) && identical(prev_b, va)
if (!att_ok) cat(glue("No attribution for {va} vs {vb} (needs `data/{vb}/attribution/` and `prev` of {vb} = {va}): the section is skipped.\n\n"))
runs_sh <- readLines(here::here("scripts/attribution_runs.sh"), warn = FALSE)
sh_get  <- function(key) sub(sprintf('^%s="([^"]*)".*$', key), "\\1", grep(sprintf('^%s="', key), runs_sh, value = TRUE))[1]   # a trailing comment is allowed
kv      <- strsplit(strsplit(sh_get("FULL"), " ")[[1]], "=")
cand_kv <- tibble(flag = tolower(sapply(kv, `[`, 1)), candidate = sapply(kv, `[`, 2))
variants_all <- strsplit(sh_get("VARIANTS"), " ")[[1]]
variants_extra <- strsplit(sh_get("EXTRA_VARIANTS"), " ")[[1]]   # follow-ups on the candidate (full2023_cal = + FOLD_DENSITY_CAL=mass), not in --all
variants_extra <- variants_extra[!is.na(variants_extra) & nzchar(variants_extra)]
sw <- regmatches(runs_sh, regexec('^\\s*(\\w+)\\)\\s+echo "\\$\\{FULL/(\\w+)=([^/]+)/\\w+=([^}]+)\\}"', runs_sh, perl = TRUE))
sw <- sw[lengths(sw) == 5]
# the runner spells booleans 0/1, the snapshots TRUE/FALSE
bool <- \(x) ifelse(x == "1", "TRUE", ifelse(x == "0", "FALSE", x))
swaps <- tibble(variant = sapply(sw, `[`, 2), flag = tolower(sapply(sw, `[`, 3)),
                on = bool(sapply(sw, `[`, 4)), off = bool(sapply(sw, `[`, 5)))

# the component labels (v11 names: Flora, Productivity) by component stem
comp_lab <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/components.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(stem = key, label, label_v10)

att_files <- if (att_ok) list.files(att_dir, "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE) else character()
att <- if (length(att_files)) bind_rows(lapply(att_files, arrow::read_parquet)) else tibble()
flag_cols <- setdiff(names(att), c("ver", "variant", "zone_set_key", "zone_fld", "zone_value", "metric_key", "val"))
# a snapshot taken before a flag existed lacks its column: that flag was at its control value then
if (nrow(att)) {
  if (!"nc_atl_source" %in% names(att)) att$nc_atl_source <- NA_character_
  if (!"fold_density_cal" %in% names(att)) att$fold_density_cal <- NA_character_
  if (!"share_basis" %in% names(att)) att$share_basis <- NA_character_
  if (!"range_fill" %in% names(att)) att$range_fill <- NA_character_
  att <- att |> mutate(nc_atl_source = coalesce(nc_atl_source, "2018"), fold_density_cal = coalesce(fold_density_cal, "none"),
                       share_basis = coalesce(share_basis, "taxon"), range_fill = coalesce(range_fill, "er"))   # SHARE_BASIS / RANGE_FILL (2026-11-02)
  flag_cols <- union(flag_cols, c("share_basis", "range_fill"))
}
present <- unique(att$variant)

cand <- c("full2023", "full")[c("full2023", "full") %in% present][1]
has_att <- att_ok && length(present) > 0 && "control" %in% present && !is.na(cand)
cand_note <- if (!att_ok) {
  ""
} else if (!has_att) {
  "The attribution needs at least `control` and a candidate (`full2023` or `full`); the section is skipped."
} else if (cand == "full") {
  "`full2023` (the candidate) is not yet snapshotted: every comparison below uses **`full`** (every flag on, the 2018 Atlantic bird source) as the candidate until it exists."
} else {
  "The candidate is **`full2023`**; `full` (the same with the 2018 Atlantic bird source) is shown as a run of its own."
}
cat(cand_note, "\n")
```

### Variants

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-variants

if (has_att) {
  flag_of <- att |> distinct(variant, across(all_of(flag_cols))) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  cand_flags <- flag_of[flag_of$variant == cand, flag_cols, drop = FALSE]
  differs <- function(v) {
    if (v %in% present) {
      f <- flag_of[flag_of$variant == v, flag_cols, drop = FALSE]
      d <- flag_cols[unlist(f[1, ]) != unlist(cand_flags[1, ])]
      if (!length(d)) return(if (v == cand) "(the candidate)" else "(none)")
      paste(sprintf("%s=%s", d, unlist(f[1, d])), collapse = ", ")
    } else if (v %in% swaps$variant) {
      s <- swaps[swaps$variant == v, ]
      sprintf("%s=%s", s$flag, s$off)
    } else if (v == "full2023") "(the candidate: every flag on, nc_atl_source=2023)" else "?"
  }
  vt <- tibble(variant = unique(c("control", "full", variants_all, variants_extra))) |>
    mutate(role = case_when(variant == cand ~ "candidate", variant == "control" ~ "control (== v10)",
                            variant %in% swaps$variant ~ "one flag at its control value",
                            variant %in% variants_extra ~ "the candidate + a follow-up setting",
                            TRUE ~ "all flags on"),
           `differs from the candidate` = sapply(variant, differs),
           status = ifelse(variant %in% present, "present", "MISSING"),
           `zone-metric rows` = sapply(variant, \(v) sum(att$variant == v)))
  miss <- vt$variant[vt$status == "MISSING"]
  knitr::kable(vt, caption = glue("{sum(vt$status == 'present')} of {nrow(vt)} variants present"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-missing
#| results: asis

if (has_att) cat(if (length(miss)) glue("**Missing variants:** {paste0('`', miss, '`', collapse = ', ')}. Their flags have no attribution row below until `scripts/attribution_runs.sh` has run them and `snapshot_scores` has written the file; every table lists only what exists.\n")
                 else "All variants are present.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-helpers
#| results: asis

if (has_att) {
  PA <- "programarea_key"
  att_pa <- att |> filter(zone_fld == PA)
  m_nat <- "score_v10_equalweights_global"
  m_eco <- grep("^score_.*ecoregion", unique(att_pa$metric_key), value = TRUE)[1]
  vec <- function(v, metric, d = att_pa) {
    x <- d[d$variant == v & d$metric_key == metric, ]
    setNames(x$val, x$zone_value)
  }
  area_nm <- function(k) if (exists("pa") && "zone_name" %in% names(pa)) pa$zone_name[match(k, pa$zone_key)] else NA_character_
  # one-flag variants that exist, in the runner's order, with the flag each owns
  singles <- swaps |> filter(variant %in% present, variant %in% variants_all) |>
    mutate(ord = match(variant, variants_all)) |> arrange(ord)
  # x, y = named vectors by area; deltas on the areas where both exist
  delta_stats <- function(x, y) {
    k <- intersect(names(x), names(y)); k <- k[!is.na(x[k]) & !is.na(y[k])]
    if (!length(k)) return(tibble(areas = 0L, `mean |Δ|` = NA_real_, `max |Δ|` = NA_real_, `at` = NA_character_, r = NA_real_, `Spearman ρ` = NA_real_))
    d <- abs(y[k] - x[k])
    tibble(areas = length(k), `mean |Δ|` = mean(d), `max |Δ|` = max(d), `at` = k[which.max(d)],
           r = if (length(k) > 2) cor(x[k], y[k]) else NA_real_,
           `Spearman ρ` = if (length(k) > 2) cor(x[k], y[k], method = "spearman") else NA_real_)
  }
  runs_vs_cand <- setdiff(intersect(c("control", "full", singles$variant), present), cand)
  mets <- c(national = m_nat, `ecoregion-rescaled` = m_eco)
  cat(glue("Program-Area composites: national `{m_nat}`; ecoregion-rescaled `{m_eco}`.\n"))
}
```

### Headline attribution

Each row compares one run with the candidate on the 20 Program Areas (areas where both runs have a
score): the mean and maximum absolute difference, the area of the maximum, and the Pearson r and Spearman ρ
between the two sets of scores. The **control** row is the whole change (v10 → candidate); each `no_<flag>`
row is what removing that one flag does. The national composite is the v10 concentration index
(100 = national average); the ecoregion-rescaled composite is a 0–100 index, so their Δ are on different scales.

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-headline
#| results: asis

if (has_att) {
  for (nm in names(mets)) {
    mm <- mets[[nm]]
    cat(glue("\n\n**{nm} composite** (`{mm}`)\n\n"))
    h <- purrr::map_dfr(runs_vs_cand, \(v) bind_cols(tibble(`run vs candidate` = v), delta_stats(vec(cand, mm), vec(v, mm)))) |>
      left_join(swaps |> select(`run vs candidate` = variant, flag), by = "run vs candidate") |>
      mutate(`flag it removes` = ifelse(is.na(flag), ifelse(`run vs candidate` == "control", "all", ""), flag), .after = 1) |>
      select(-flag) |>
      mutate(across(c(`mean |Δ|`, `max |Δ|`), \(x) round(x, 2)), across(c(r, `Spearman ρ`), \(x) round(x, 3)))
    if (nrow(h)) print(knitr::kable(h, caption = glue("{nm}: runs vs the candidate `{cand}`"))) else cat("No run to compare yet.\n")
  }
}
```

#### Per Program Area: the delta each flag owns

For each Program Area: the candidate's score, the control's, and the delta each flag owns (candidate minus
the run without that flag). **sum of flag deltas** adds the single-flag deltas of the flags present;
**candidate − control** is the whole change. The difference between the two is the **interaction**:
what the flags do together that none does alone (or the flags whose run is still missing).

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-area-fn

area_tab <- function(mm) {
  ck <- vec(cand, mm); k0 <- vec("control", mm)
  keys <- names(ck)
  out <- tibble(`Program Area` = keys, Name = area_nm(keys), candidate = unname(ck), control = unname(k0[keys]))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(singles))) out[[singles$flag[i]]] <- unname(ck[keys] - vec(singles$variant[i], mm)[keys])
  fl <- if (nrow(singles)) singles$flag else character()
  out |> mutate(`sum of flag deltas` = if (length(fl)) rowSums(across(all_of(fl)), na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
                `candidate − control` = candidate - control,
                interaction = `candidate − control` - `sum of flag deltas`) |>
    arrange(desc(candidate))
}
area_dt <- function(nm) {
  at <- area_tab(mets[[nm]])
  DT::datatable(at, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
                caption = glue("{nm}: candidate `{cand}`, control, and the delta each flag owns (candidate minus the run without it); flags present: ",
                               "{if (nrow(singles)) paste(singles$flag, collapse = ', ') else 'none'}")) |>
    DT::formatRound(setdiff(names(at), c("Program Area", "Name")), 1)
}
```

**National composite**

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-area-nat

if (has_att) area_dt("national")
```

**Ecoregion-rescaled composite**

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-area-eco

if (has_att) area_dt("ecoregion-rescaled")
```

### Components

The same comparison for each component score under the national scoring (`extrisk_{category}_v10_global`
and `primprod_v10`), over the Program Areas: per flag and component, the mean and maximum |Δ| where both runs
report it, and the Program Areas where the flag **adds** the component (the candidate reports it, the run without the
flag does not) or **removes** it (the reverse). An absent row is a component with too little coverage in that
area to report under the 5 % floor, never a zero. Labels are the v11 names from `data/components.csv`.

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-components

if (has_att) {
  cmet <- grep("^(extrisk_.*_v10_global|primprod_v10)$", unique(att_pa$metric_key), value = TRUE)
  cstem <- ifelse(cmet == "primprod_v10", "primprod", sub("^extrisk_(.*)_v10_global$", "\\1", cmet))
  clab  <- comp_lab$label[match(cstem, comp_lab$stem)]
  clab  <- ifelse(is.na(clab), cstem, clab)
  runs_c <- c(control = "control", setNames(singles$variant, singles$flag))
  runs_c <- runs_c[runs_c %in% present & runs_c != cand]
  ct <- purrr::map_dfr(names(runs_c), \(fl) purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(cmet), \(i) {
    x <- vec(cand, cmet[i]); y <- vec(runs_c[[fl]], cmet[i])
    s <- delta_stats(x, y)
    tibble(`flag removed` = fl, Component = clab[i], `both report` = s$areas,
           `mean |Δ|` = s$`mean |Δ|`, `max |Δ|` = s$`max |Δ|`, `at` = s$at,
           `flag adds it in` = paste(sort(setdiff(names(x), names(y))), collapse = " "),
           `flag removes it in` = paste(sort(setdiff(names(y), names(x))), collapse = " "))
  }))
  if (nrow(ct)) {
    wide <- ct |> select(`flag removed`, Component, `mean |Δ|`) |>
      mutate(`mean |Δ|` = round(`mean |Δ|`, 2)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = Component, values_from = `mean |Δ|`)
    print(knitr::kable(wide, caption = glue("Mean |Δ| per Program Area, candidate `{cand}` minus the run without the flag ('control' = every flag removed)")))
  } else cat("No run to compare yet.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-components-detail

if (has_att && exists("ct") && nrow(ct)) {
  DT::datatable(ct |> mutate(across(c(`mean |Δ|`, `max |Δ|`), \(x) round(x, 2))), rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE),
                caption = glue("Flag × component over Program Areas. flag adds it in = areas where `{cand}` reports the component and the run without the flag does not; flag removes it in = the reverse"))
}
```

### After the candidate: single counting and the range fill

The candidate above still counts extinction risk the v4–v10 way. Three settings decided on 2026-11-02
(see [What each flag means](#attribution-which-flag-moved-which-score)) take it to the published release,
one step at a time:

1. **single counting** where a suitability model covers the range cell (`share_basis = cell`), keeping the
   risk score on unmodelled range cells (`range_fill = er`);
2. **the mean fill**: an unmodelled range cell takes the mean of the species' modelled range cells
   (`range_fill = mean`) instead of its risk score;
3. **the survey calibration** on the suitability prior (`fold_density_cal = suit`): this gives the
   published **v11**.

`presence` (an unmodelled range cell = 100) was measured as the alternative to step 2 and is shown beside it.

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-steps-setup
#| results: asis

STEPS <- tibble(
  variant = c(if (exists("cand")) cand else NA_character_, "full2023_basis_er", "full2023_basis_mean", "v11"),
  step    = c("candidate", "1 single counting (er fill)", "2 mean fill", "3 calibration = v11"))
alt_step <- tibble(variant = "full2023_basis", step = "alt: presence fill")
has_steps <- has_att && all(STEPS$variant %in% present)
if (has_att && !has_steps)
  cat(glue("Steps missing from `data/{vb}/attribution/`: {paste(setdiff(STEPS$variant, present), collapse = ', ')}; the subsection is skipped.\n"))
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-steps-summary
#| results: asis

if (has_steps) {
  st <- bind_rows(STEPS, alt_step |> filter(variant %in% present))
  prev_of <- c(setNames(STEPS$variant[-nrow(STEPS)], STEPS$variant[-1]), full2023_basis = "full2023_basis_er")
  for (nm in names(mets)) {
    mm <- mets[[nm]]
    s_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(st$variant[-1], \(v) bind_cols(
      tibble(step = st$step[st$variant == v], `from → to` = glue("{prev_of[[v]]} → {v}")),
      delta_stats(vec(prev_of[[v]], mm), vec(v, mm)))) |>
      bind_rows(bind_cols(tibble(step = "all steps", `from → to` = glue("{cand} → v11")), delta_stats(vec(cand, mm), vec("v11", mm))),
                bind_cols(tibble(step = "whole change", `from → to` = glue("control ({va}) → v11")), delta_stats(vec("control", mm), vec("v11", mm)))) |>
      mutate(across(c(`mean |Δ|`, `max |Δ|`), \(x) round(x, 2)), across(c(r, `Spearman ρ`), \(x) round(x, 3)))
    print(knitr::kable(s_tab, caption = glue("{nm} composite: each step vs the one before it, over the Program Areas")))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-steps-area

if (has_steps) {
  stp <- bind_rows(tibble(variant = "control", step = glue("control ({va})")), STEPS)
  w <- purrr::map_dfc(seq_len(nrow(stp)), \(i) {
    x <- vec(stp$variant[i], m_nat); tibble(!!stp$step[i] := unname(x[names(vec(cand, m_nat))]))
  })
  at <- bind_cols(tibble(`Program Area` = names(vec(cand, m_nat)), Name = area_nm(names(vec(cand, m_nat)))), w) |>
    mutate(`Δ steps 1–3` = .data[["3 calibration = v11"]] - .data[["candidate"]],
           `Δ control → v11` = .data[["3 calibration = v11"]] - .data[[glue("control ({va})")]]) |>
    arrange(desc(.data[["3 calibration = v11"]]))
  DT::datatable(at, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
                caption = "National composite per Program Area at each step (100 = national average)") |>
    DT::formatRound(setdiff(names(at), c("Program Area", "Name")), 1)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-steps-fig
#| fig-height: 7.5
#| fig-width: 9

  stp <- bind_rows(tibble(variant = "control", step = glue("control ({va})")), STEPS)
  sp <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(stp)), \(i) {

  }) |> mutate(area = factor(area, names(sort(vec("v11", m_nat)))), step = factor(step, stp$step))
  pal_s <- setNames(c("grey55", "#000000", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00"), stp$step)
  shp_s <- setNames(c(21, 16, 16, 16, 18), stp$step)
  ggplot(sp, aes(score, area)) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

### The occurrence rule's reach

The occurrence rule (`occ_rule`) gates a species out of an ecoregion where it has **no OBIS record** under
adequate search effort; where it is recorded but rarely, `region_weight` downweights it by its encounter weight
`w` there (its record rate in the ecoregion over its rate elsewhere).
`data/v11/zone_exclusions_occ.csv` holds the gated pairs and `data/v11/zone_weights_occ.csv` the weighted ones
(a gated pair is `w = 0` there); both come from [the exploration notebook](explore_occurrence_rule.html).
The denominator is each component's species count in the ecoregion (`extrisk_{category}_n_species`) of the run
without the rule, so the percentage is the share of the component's species there that the rule touches.

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-occ
#| results: asis

f_ex <- here::here("data", vb, "zone_exclusions_occ.csv"); f_w <- here::here("data", vb, "zone_weights_occ.csv")
has_occ <- has_att && file.exists(f_ex) && file.exists(f_w)
if (has_att && !has_occ) cat("The occurrence-rule CSVs are not on disk: this subsection is skipped.\n")
if (has_occ) {
  ex <- readr::read_csv(f_ex, show_col_types = FALSE)
  wt <- readr::read_csv(f_w,  show_col_types = FALSE)
  base_run <- c("no_occ_rule", "control")[c("no_occ_rule", "control") %in% present][1]
  den <- att |> filter(zone_fld == "ecoregion_key", variant == base_run, grepl("^extrisk_.*_n_species$", metric_key)) |>
    transmute(ecoregion = zone_value, sp_cat = sub("^extrisk_(.*)_n_species$", "\\1", metric_key), n_in_zone = val)
  gated <- ex |> distinct(mdl_key, ecoregion = zone_key, sp_cat) |> count(ecoregion, sp_cat, name = "gated")
  wtd   <- wt |> filter(w > 0, w < 1) |> group_by(ecoregion = zone_key, sp_cat) |>
    summarise(weighted = n_distinct(mdl_key), `median w` = median(w), .groups = "drop")
  reach <- full_join(gated, wtd, by = c("ecoregion", "sp_cat")) |>
    left_join(den, by = c("ecoregion", "sp_cat")) |>
    mutate(across(c(gated, weighted), \(x) coalesce(x, 0L)),
           affected = gated + weighted,
           `% of the component's species` = 100 * affected / n_in_zone,
           Component = coalesce(comp_lab$label[match(sp_cat, comp_lab$stem)], sp_cat)) |>
    arrange(ecoregion, sp_cat)
  cat(glue("Species counts from `{base_run}`; {nrow(ex)} gated and {sum(wt$w > 0 & wt$w < 1)} downweighted ",
           "(species, ecoregion) pairs over {n_distinct(c(ex$mdl_key, wt$mdl_key))} species.\n"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-occ-table

if (has_occ && nrow(reach)) {
  reach |> transmute(Ecoregion = ecoregion, Component, `species in zone` = n_in_zone, gated, weighted,
                     `median w` = round(`median w`, 3), `% affected` = round(`% of the component's species`, 1)) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE),
                  caption = "Occurrence rule: species gated (w = 0) and downweighted (0 < w < 1) per ecoregion and component")
}
```

```{r}
if (has_occ && nrow(reach)) {
  reach |> transmute(Ecoregion = ecoregion, Component, pct = round(`% of the component's species`, 1)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Component, values_from = pct) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = "Share (%) of each component's species in the ecoregion that the rule gates or downweights")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-occ-mt

if (has_occ) {
  mt <- c("mammal", "turtle")
  g <- ex |> filter(sp_cat %in% mt) |>
    transmute(Ecoregion = zone_key, Component = comp_lab$label[match(sp_cat, comp_lab$stem)], Species = scientific_name,
              `Common name` = common_name, w = 0, `n searched` = n_searched, `n occupied` = n_occupied, Reason = reason) |>
    arrange(Component, Species, Ecoregion)
  if (nrow(g)) DT::datatable(g, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
                             caption = glue("Marine mammal and sea turtle pairs gated out ({nrow(g)}; w = 0)"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-occ-low

if (has_occ) {
  lo <- wt |> filter(sp_cat %in% c("mammal", "turtle"), w > 0, w < 1) |> arrange(w) |> slice_head(n = 20) |>
    transmute(Ecoregion = zone_key, Component = comp_lab$label[match(sp_cat, comp_lab$stem)], Species = scientific_name,
              `Common name` = common_name, w = signif(w, 3), `n searched` = n_searched, `n occupied` = n_occupied,
              rate = signif(rate, 3), `baseline rate` = signif(p_core, 3))
  if (nrow(lo)) knitr::kable(lo, caption = "The 20 most downweighted marine mammal and sea turtle pairs that are not gated (smallest w > 0)")
}
```

### Figures

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-lollipop
#| fig-height: 7.5
#| fig-width: 9

if (has_att) {
  run_ord <- c("control", singles$variant, cand) |> unique() |> intersect(present)
  lp <- purrr::map_dfr(run_ord, \(v) tibble(run = v, area = names(vec(v, m_nat)), score = unname(vec(v, m_nat))))
  area_lv <- names(sort(vec(cand, m_nat)))
  lp <- lp |> mutate(area = factor(area, area_lv), run = factor(run, run_ord))
  # Okabe-Ito for the flag runs; the control is an open circle, the candidate a large black dot
  pal <- setNames(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999")[seq_len(nrow(singles))], singles$variant)
  ggplot(lp, aes(score, area)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = area), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = filter(lp, run %in% singles$variant), aes(colour = run), size = 2.4) +
    geom_point(data = filter(lp, run == "control"), shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3) +
    geom_point(data = filter(lp, run == cand), colour = "black", size = 3.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = "candidate minus one flag") +
    labs(x = glue("national composite {m_nat}  (100 = national average)"), y = NULL,
         title = glue("Program Areas: control (open), each single-flag run, candidate {cand} (black)"),
         caption = "The candidate precedes single counting and the mean fill; see After the candidate for the steps to the published release.") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-att-heatmap
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10

if (has_att && nrow(singles)) {
  hm <- purrr::map_dfr(c(singles$variant, "control"), \(v) {
    x <- vec(cand, m_nat); y <- vec(v, m_nat)
    tibble(flag = if (v == "control") "all flags (vs control)" else singles$flag[match(v, singles$variant)],
           area = names(x), delta = unname(x - y[names(x)]))
  }) |> mutate(area = factor(area, names(sort(vec(cand, m_nat), decreasing = TRUE))),
               flag = factor(flag, rev(unique(flag))))
  lim <- max(abs(hm$delta), na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(hm, aes(area, flag, fill = delta)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(delta), "", format(round(delta), trim = TRUE)), colour = abs(delta) > 0.6 * lim), size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black")) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim), na.value = "grey90",
                         name = "Δ") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = glue("National composite: candidate {cand} minus the run without each flag")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
}
```
